name: band_13_15_community_action
value: guardian co-sign required; narrower supervised envelope optional; no solo action

name: minor_geolocation_default
value: off by default for every band under 18; precise exposure never waivable

name: reversible_pending_admissible_tier
value: T1 provisional (T0 is the emergency doctrine and confers no standing)

name: incapacity_hard_deadline, incapacity_t2_review_cadence
value: no document value; set by the community's policy and named in the binding row

name: accord_holder_count
value: N, an instance parameter read from the standing roster; 3 at the seed

name: noise_floor_epsilon
value: operator-tunable per media type; an item at exactly ε is below the floor

name: root_conferral_threshold
value: strict majority of the standing accord roster (2·yes > N)

name: shaped_frame_bytes
value: 1,400 bytes before the E1 seal, or the link's channel MDU where smaller; one constant for the fleet

name: shaping_off_node_asked_class
value: the node's own device class; `off` yields an unshaped link only when neither end asks

name: shaped_link_bound
value: 8 shaped links per node, each at its class's full rate; `seat` links outside the eight

name: asked_shaped_link_idle_secs
value: 600 s (ten minutes) after the last real frame, cover not counting; default, operator-settable

name: shaped_file_max_bytes
value: 64 KiB (65,536 bytes) by the file's whole size; more than that never crosses a shaped link

name: entrenchment_quorum
value: strict majority of the standing accord roster; never lower, before or after the scale gate

name: unanimous_removal_denominator
value: every member other than the target, and those signers a strict majority of the roster

name: admission_freshness_window_secs
value: W = 259,200 s (72 h), fixed; an accord roster change's `window_until` starts at W and reaches at most 604,800 s (7 d)

name: community_floor_voices
value: 2 voices for any change to who is in a room; min(2, roster size) for the moderator election

name: moderation_fallback_window_secs
value: 172,800 s (48 h), class ruled_48h; the reversible-content class is 86,400 s (content_24h)

name: phone_relay_default
value: relays while charging on an unmetered network, reports no capacity otherwise; default, the owner MAY override either way

name: onion_layer_floor
value: 3 relays dealt to each of the three layers; separately, 3 answering relays per layer for liveness

name: rendezvous_mailbox_retention_secs
value: 7,200 s (two hours) of ciphertext, read from item 6's delivery statement; the text states only 'hour-scale'

name: census_k_floor
value: k = 10 sources per cell, a source being one owner (one accepted return per owner per period)

name: withhold_window_dmca512
value: 10 days, counted on each holder from the instant it executes the tombstone

name: bilateral_ratification_predicate
value: both halves present and live under one bilateral_pair_id

name: charter_change_threshold
value: strict majority of the standing accord roster; every holder signs only a fresh genesis bundle

name: moderator_eligibility_track_record_min
value: none; a track record orders the ballot and is never a bar to candidacy

name: first_cosignature_prior
value: signed field empty; descent anchored at the lineage's genesis head from the bundle

name: custody_claims_per_key
value: at most 1 live owner-binding per key; steward set at most 2 anchors (one occurrence, one custody)

name: replication_target_cap
value: effective target = min(owner's target, audience size); a larger target is read down, never refused

name: envelope_cap_bytes
value: 1,048,576 bytes of JCS image; exactly the cap admits, one byte more is refused ENVELOPE_TOO_LARGE

name: trust_walk_hop_cap
value: 5 hops, consumer default, for every policy; an entry's `trust_depth` is 0..5, absent reads 0

name: witness_quorum_absent
value: 0 (witnessed mode off); when set, ⌊|witnesses|/2⌋ + 1 and at least 2

name: membership_proposal_max_secs
value: at most 30 days after the proposal's `asserted_at`

name: delegation_term_max_secs
value: at most 365 days (365 × 86 400 s) after `delegation_valid_from`

name: custody_report_ttl_secs
value: 259,200 s (72 hours) from the report's instant; older reads as unknown

name: mesh_config_emergency_ttl_secs
value: at most 259,200 s (72 h) for the emergency form

name: session_claim_max_secs
value: 86,400 s: `valid_until − claimed_at` never exceeds it

name: withhold_window_dsa16
value: 14 days, counted on each holder from the instant it executes the tombstone

name: withhold_window_osa
value: 14 days, counted on each holder from the instant it executes the tombstone

name: withhold_window_community_standards
value: 30 days, counted on each holder from the instant it executes the tombstone

name: accord_heartbeat_max_secs
value: at most 90 days between refreshes of the heartbeat's `valid_until`

name: accord_roster_window_max_secs
value: 604,800 s (7 d): the most an accord roster change's `window_until` reaches, under a declared severe-degradation state

name: consent_temporary_ttl_secs
value: 14 days from `asserted_at` for a temporary grant that states no `valid_until`

name: epoch_key_retention_secs
value: 30 days: the rotate-forward window after which holders delete past-epoch keys (the default mode)
